```{r init, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(bigrquery)
library(gt)
library(glue)
library(blastula)
source("helpers.R")

global_font <- "Futura"
rb_red <- "#DD0741"
rb_blue <- "#001F47"
```

```{r data-pull}
# --- Date range ---
date_to   <- Sys.Date()
date_from <- as.Date(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-01-01"))

# --- BigQuery connection ---
bq_con <- get_my_local_db_access_SDP2()

# --- Loan player IDs (RBNY and RB2) ---
rbny_loan_players <- dbGetQuery(bq_con,
                                "SELECT
  COALESCE(t3.player_nickname, t3.player_name) as player,
  t1.player_id_scoutastic,
	t2.player_id_statsbomb,
	t4.team_id_scoutastic,
	t5.team_id_transfermarkt,
	t5.team_id_statsbomb,
	t6.team_name as team,
	t6.age_category,
	t7.date_from as loan_team_joined_date
FROM
	`40_intermediate_scoutastic.int_players` t1
	LEFT JOIN `10_meta_sdp_mappings.players_mapping` t2 ON t1.player_id_scoutastic = t2.player_id_scoutastic
	LEFT JOIN `40_intermediate_statsbomb.int_players` t3 ON t2.player_id_statsbomb = t3.player_id_statsbomb
	LEFT JOIN `40_intermediate_scoutastic.int_player_teams` t4 ON t1.player_id_scoutastic = t4.player_id_scoutastic
	LEFT JOIN `10_meta_sdp_mappings.teams_mapping` t5 ON t4.team_id_scoutastic = t5.team_id_scoutastic
	LEFT JOIN `40_intermediate_scoutastic.int_teams` t6 ON t4.team_id_scoutastic = t6.team_id_scoutastic
	LEFT JOIN `40_intermediate_scoutastic.int_player_team_history_windows` t7 ON (t1.player_id_scoutastic = t7.player_id_scoutastic AND t4.team_id_scoutastic = t7.team_id_scoutastic)
WHERE
	t1.on_loan_from_team_id_transfermarkt IN ('623', '39815')
	AND t6.is_national_team = FALSE
") 

rbny_loan_players_clean <- rbny_loan_players %>%
  group_by(player_id_scoutastic) %>%
  mutate(
    loan_team_joined_date = if_else(
      is.na(loan_team_joined_date) & any(!is.na(loan_team_joined_date)),
      loan_team_joined_date[!is.na(loan_team_joined_date)][1],
      loan_team_joined_date
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(loan_team_joined_date == max(loan_team_joined_date, na.rm = TRUE) | is.na(loan_team_joined_date),
         !is.na(age_category)) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- Pull data: need a separate pull for A. Stokes ----
player_loan_stats_statsbomb <- get_loan_player_stats(bq_con, rbny_loan_players_clean %>% 
                                                       filter(player != "Aidan Stokes"), date_from, date_to)

player_loan_stats_scoutastic <- get_loan_player_stats_scoutastic(bq_con, rbny_loan_players_clean %>% 
                                                                   filter(player == "Aidan Stokes"), date_from, date_to)

# Combine 
player_loan_stats_combined <- bind_rows(
    player_loan_stats_statsbomb %>% mutate(across(ends_with("_last_match"), as.character)),
    player_loan_stats_scoutastic %>% mutate(across(ends_with("_last_match"), as.character))
  )
```

```{r week-label}
# --- Derived values for inline text ---
time_label <- glue("{format(date_from, '%B %d, %Y')} to {format(date_to, '%B %d, %Y')}")
```

```{r stats-table}
clean_table <- player_loan_stats_combined %>% 
  mutate(squad_made_last_match = case_when(
    squad_made_last_match == "1" ~ "Yes",
    squad_made_last_match == "?" ~ "?",
    TRUE ~ "No"
  )) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_minutes)) %>%
  select(
    player,
    team,
    team_games_played,
    total_squads_made,
    total_starts,
    start_pct,
    total_minutes,
    total_goals,
    total_assists,
    last_match,
    squad_made_last_match,
    minutes_last_match,
    next_match
  )
  

stats_table <- clean_table %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), as.character)) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title    = "RBNY Loan Player Report",
    subtitle = glue("From {time_label}")
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    player            = "Player",
    team              = "Team",
    team_games_played = "Team Games Played",
    total_squads_made       = "Squads Made",
    total_starts            = "Starts",
    start_pct         = "Start %",
    total_minutes     = "Min.",
    total_goals       = "Goals",
    total_assists     = "Assists",
    last_match        = "Last Match",
    squad_made_last_match = "Squad Made Last Match?",
    minutes_last_match = "Min. Last Match",
    next_match = "Next Match"
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = c(total_goals, total_assists),
      rows    = (total_goals > 0 | total_assists > 0)
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(font = global_font),
    locations = cells_title()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style     = cell_text(font = global_font),
    locations = cells_body()
  ) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center") %>% 
  tab_options(
    table.width                    = pct(100),
    heading.background.color       = rb_blue,
    heading.title.font.size        = px(30),
    heading.subtitle.font.size      = px(18),
    column_labels.font.size = px(12),
    table.font.size = px(12),
    column_labels.font.weight      = "bold",
    column_labels.background.color = "#f0f0f0"
  ) %>%
  sub_missing(missing_text = "—")

stats_table
```

```{r notable-performances, results='asis'}
scorers   <- player_loan_stats_combined %>% filter(goals_last_match > 0)
assisters <- player_loan_stats_combined %>% filter(assists_last_match > 0)
starters  <- player_loan_stats_combined %>% filter(start_last_match > 0)
full_90s  <- player_loan_stats_combined %>% filter(full_90_last_match > 0)
player_injuries <- get_loan_player_injuries(bq_con, rbny_loan_players_clean)

dbDisconnect(bq_con)

if (nrow(scorers) > 0)   cat("⚽ **Goal Scorers:** ",  paste(scorers$player,   collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
if (nrow(assisters) > 0) cat("🅰️ **Assists:** ",       paste(assisters$player, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
if (nrow(starters) > 0) cat("🟢️ **Starters:** ",       paste(starters$player, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
if (nrow(full_90s) > 0)  cat("💪 **Full 90s:** ",      paste(full_90s$player,  collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
if (nrow(player_injuries) > 0) cat("🤕 **Injury Report:** ", 
    paste(glue("{player_injuries$player} ({player_injuries$injury}, Sustained {player_injuries$date_from})"), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
```

```{r attach-email, include=FALSE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE, cache = FALSE}
email_obj <- render_connect_email(
  input = "loan_player_email.Rmd",
  envir = knitr::knit_global()
)

message("DEBUG email_obj class: ", paste(class(email_obj), collapse = ", "))
message("DEBUG email_obj is null: ", is.null(email_obj))

attach_connect_email(
  email         = email_obj,
  subject       = glue("RBNY Loan Player Update — {format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')}"),
  attach_output = TRUE
)

message("DEBUG attach_connect_email completed")
```
